findings.title: False comment rationale: start_run's pullback-clear is NOT independent of the camera routing — the :972 routing call is the only clear on that path, and that half is unpinned
findings.evidence: Diff comment: 'NOTE: start_run clears pullback via its destroy-then-reinit run-init independent of the camera routing'. FALSE: run_init/run_destroy take ^Run_State (core/types.odin:561/582); pullback is an App field (main.odin:263). Only clear on the path: camera_set_default's app.pullback=false (main.odin:1763) via :972. Perkins mutation leg (scratch test): armed pullback + start_run → cleared pristine; with :972 removed → pullback stays TRUE.
findings.detail: A maintainer trusting the comment could re-route the :972 camera call and silently lose restart's pullback-clear — the exact mutation-blind class this PR pins. The sibling tests pin their clears; start_run's is skipped on a false premise.
findings.recommended_fix: Arm app.pullback=true before start_run(&app,42) and assert false after (verified: passes pristine, fails with :972 removed); rewrite the NOTE — the clear rides the routing call itself, not run-init.
